# Organization artwork

These assets identify the organizations and projects described on the
[Ecosystem and Community](../../ecosystem.md) page. Logos supplement visible
names and relationship descriptions; they do not imply a general endorsement or
formal partnership.

Retrieved on 9–10 October 2026 from the sources below. The original colors and
drawings are preserved. LRZ, planqc, and VTT artwork was extracted from inline
SVG markup on their official websites. Raster assets are included unchanged.

SVGs have a background rectangle: white, or dark blue for WMI's white logo.
VTT's original orange rectangle is retained unchanged. This preserves contrast
in both themes, including on GitHub where the stylesheet is unavailable. The
documentation stylesheet also provides white backgrounds for raster assets.
Images retain their original aspect ratios. Empty image alternatives avoid
repeating the adjacent visible organization names.

Copyright and trademark rights remain with the respective owners. These assets
are not relicensed under QDMI's source-code license. Retain source notices and
consult the linked owners' terms for other uses. The IQM SVG includes its own
Apache-2.0-with-LLVM-exception notice, which is retained unchanged.

## Additional Artwork and Licenses

- **Amazon Web Services** (`aws.svg`): copyright Amazon Web Services, provided
  under the [Apache License 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) on
  [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Amazon_Web_Services_Logo.svg).
  A white background was added; the logo is otherwise unchanged. Trademark
  rights remain with Amazon. The license is retained in `aws-LICENSE.txt`.
- **IBM Quantum Platform** (`ibm-quantum.svg`): IBM's wordmark from
  [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:IBM_Quantum_Platform_logo.svg),
  where it is identified as public-domain text artwork. A white background was
  added; the logo is otherwise unchanged. Trademark rights remain with IBM.
- **CESGA** (`cesga.jpg`): *Logotipo CESGA original*, by
  [Promocioncesga](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Promocioncesga), from
  [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Logotipo_CESGA_original.jpg),
  licensed under
  [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Included
  unchanged under that license, separately from QDMI's source-code license.
- **Oak Ridge National Laboratory** (`ornl.svg`): the
  [official green logo](https://fact-sheets.ornl.gov/assets/logo_ornl_green.svg)
  from ORNL's Research Activity Index. Courtesy of Oak Ridge National
  Laboratory, U.S. Dept. of Energy. See ORNL's
  [copyright notice](https://www.ornl.gov/security-privacy-notice/). A white
  background was added; the logo is otherwise unchanged.
- **openQSE** (`openqse.png`): the unchanged
  [homepage logo](https://openqse.org/assets/img/openQSE-logo.png) from the
  [openQSE website repository](https://github.com/openQSE/openqse.github.io),
  which includes the
  [MIT license](https://github.com/openQSE/openqse.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE)
  retained alongside it as `openqse-LICENSE.txt`.
- **FullStaQD** (`fullstaqd.png`): the unchanged
  [project logo](https://github.com/FullStaQD/architecture/blob/main/docs/images/fullstaqd-logo-name.png)
  from the consortium's architecture repository. Used to identify FullStaQD;
  copyright and trademark rights remain with their owners.
- **MQT** (`mqt.svg`): from the
  [official MQT artwork collection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/munich-quantum-toolkit/.github/main/docs/_static/logo-mqt-light.svg).
  A white background was added; the logo is otherwise unchanged.
- **CINECA** (`cineca.png`): the
  [official wordmark](https://www.cineca.it/sites/default/files/cineca/logo-cineca.png),
  retrieved from
  [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cineca-logo.png),
  where it is identified as public-domain text artwork. Included unchanged;
  trademark rights remain with CINECA.
- **VTT** (`vtt.svg`): the original orange logo extracted from the
  [VTT Design System](https://styleguide.vttresearch.com/en/brand-basics). Its
  drawing and background are unchanged. See the
  [logo guidelines](https://styleguide.vttresearch.com/en/brand-basics/logo-and-brand-promise)
  and [editorial-use terms](https://www.vttresearch.com/en/news-stories/media).
- **Eviden** (`eviden.png`): the unchanged
  [official homepage logo](https://eviden.com/sites/default/files/2026-07/eviden-logo-black.png).
  Used to identify the provider of Qaptiva; copyright and trademark rights
  remain with Eviden.
